discoveries.summary: The Army awarded AeroVironment a $464.8M Enduring-High Energy Laser production contract on Sept. 3, and the Air Force is also speeding a cheaper Reaper successor after Iran losses, giving AVAV two fresh drone-and-directed-energy catalysts tied to the same battlefield lesson.

discoveries.summary: Vertiv announced on September 2, 2026 that it is acquiring UtilityInnovation Group to speed time-to-power for AI data centers, reinforcing its role as a critical power and cooling bottleneck beneficiary.

discoveries.summary: Republic Services has one of the strongest insider signals in the group, with Cascade/Bill Gates buying a very large block while the business continues to print solid operating results.

discoveries.summary: DKS is about 43% below its 52-week high after the Aug. 25 Q2 disappointment, but the post-earnings washout has already drawn fresh insider buying from multiple directors between Aug. 27 and Sep. 4 and management still has a meaningful buyback/dividend machine; bear case is that footwear demand stays weak and the Foot Locker integration drags longer than expected.

discoveries.summary: PYPL is still roughly 29% below its 52-week high while trading at just over 10x earnings, and the next hard catalyst is its third-quarter earnings call on Sep. 9, 2026 after a Q2 print that beat estimates and raised guidance; bear case is that market share losses keep capping multiple expansion even if the quarter is clean.
